channel.title: Python & Thonny :: Coursebook Informatics
channel.description: Thonny is the Python development environment of this course. It ships with Python, has a built-in shell, a beginner-friendly debugger and can later talk directly to MicroPython boards. One tool for the whole year. Installation ​ Windows macOS Linux Browser (fallback) Download the installer from thonny.org (button “Windows”). Run the installer, keep the default settings. Python is included, nothing else needs to be installed. Start Thonny from the start menu. On school PCs Thonny is already installed; if not, thonny.org also offers a portable version that runs from a folder or USB stick without install rights.
